notes: worker_enter follows the trace record's initial reserve; trace setup before this point remains in the outside-worker residual.
API contains resampling and engine intervals; engine contains frontend, encode and decode; encode contains build, compute, read and graph cleanup. These overlapping intervals are not additive.
The engine encoder span includes graph cleanup before returning, unlike the standalone stage tool's core_total boundary.
finish_before is before the terminal protocol write and is safely contained in the Python request timer. terminal_flush_after and worker_exit are not guaranteed to precede the Python timer end.
pcm_float_cleanup_ms covers the end of the worker try scope after terminal construction, including destruction of its float input; it is not a direct allocator-only measurement.

The initial diagnostic has no reader-thread or client subinterval timers. Its outside-worker residual does not separate Python serialization, pipe transfer, C++ line/JSON/base64 processing, queue delay or end reception.
